description: This source file defines the WebViewJavaScriptSupport enum which provides static methods to interact with WKWebView for executing JavaScript code, setting debug statuses, evaluating JavaScript to String, and converting values for JavaScript injection.

methods.name: applyDebugStatus
methods.description: Injects JavaScript into the web view to set debug status and optional status messages via a global JavaScript API, executed on the main actor.

methods.name: evaluateToString
methods.description: Evaluates a JavaScript expression in the web view and asynchronously returns the result as a String, handling errors appropriately.

methods.name: jsValue
methods.description: Converts an optional String into a JavaScript-compatible value, encoding it as JSON if possible.
